slate_notes: Tuesday thin slate: 3 NBA (DET @ ORL 7:11, BOS @ WAS 8:10, DAL @ DEN 10:10) and 1 NHL (VGK @ EDM 8:10). No NFL (Thanksgiving is Thu). 6 legs across 4 games (max 2 per game, opposite-direction or different teams), 5 overs and 1 under. Fewer than the usual 8-12 because the slate is small and independence rules bind. Every leg is a per-book devig median at the exact line with 3-6 books (P1), priced 9:44 AM ET; the under is shaded -3. Skipped: Barbashev O0.5 SOG (0.5 line, 2 books), Hertl U2.5 SOG (3+ in 7/10), Olofsson O1.5 SOG and Kyshawn George / Dybantsa assists (same-game thesis concentration), Ausar Thompson O7.5 reb (same Duren-out thesis as Jenkins, 55.4%). Cooldown respected (no Nov 21-23 misses repeated). Confirm each line in the app and skip Goblin/Demon lines.

legs.reasoning: Pritchard is running Boston's second-unit/combo-guard offense at 28-34 min lately and has 4+ assists in 8 of his last 10 (4,8,2,5,6,1,5,4,5,5). Washington is thin (Vukcevic, Beekman, Champagnie, Watkins out) and plays fast, which keeps possessions up. Five books devigged at 3.5.
legs.injury_notes: BOS: Mitchell Robinson out (illness). WAS: Vukcevic, Beekman, Champagnie, Watkins out.
